core_obligations: Preserve weighted undirected model, edge-weight ratio and adjacency matrix/array distinctions.
Combine query and time bounds and all supporting algorithms in one main item.
Retain complete weighted contraction, atom-learning and Karger-generalization proof chain.
difficulty_reason: The authors combine a weighted near-minimum-cut contraction bound with quantum sparsification and enumeration, then implement atom learning via generating sets of two-respecting cuts, quantum spanning forests and Euler-tour-tree hashing. The AppendixA tree-packing generalization closes the time bound. This is one nonroutine algorithmic construction across both oracle models.

dedup.scope: Root refreshed official DOI, arxiv2011.09823 and standard arXiv DOI across complete legacy/prepared/both lines, zero matches. Related arxiv2110.15587 and1911.07306 are different works and not aliases. Query/time algorithms grouped once.
